inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The session [...] The post Terry Pheto Linked To R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe appeared first on SurgeZirc SA .
inputs.modified_text: The alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal is about more than one high-profile name: it raises questions about who gets access to public money, and whether powerful people face the same scrutiny as everyone else. Terry Pheto has been linked to the funding in a parliamentary briefing on 24 March 2026, but an allegation is not proof of guilt. The SIU investigation must establish what happened, transparently and fairly. Public funds should serve the public good, and celebrity or political connections must not shield anyone from accountability.
